about.text: Rūgpienis is the most traditional soured milk of Lithuania: milk thickened by lactic acid streptococci into a firm, sour, white-to-cream product, eaten with porridge, potatoes and bread. Homemade, fresh milk is left to sour in a warm room; industrially a chosen bacterial starter is added to the prepared milk.
